text: NE RB TreVeyon Henderson high ankle sprain, multi-week, no surgery expected.
ATL QB Michael Penix rib injury not considered serious; might return Week 6 vs CHI pending practice.
SF WR Deebo Samuel hamstring — miss at least a couple weeks; Pearsall season (PCL); other WRs long-term.
SF LB Dre Greenlaw suspended 1 game (headbutt) — out MNF vs WAS (appealing per Rapoport).
GB not anticipating Micah Parsons return to practice this week vs DAL; knee timeline uncertain.
HOU RB David Montgomery groin week-to-week (DeMeco Ryans).
JAX LT Anton Harrison expected arthroscopic knee surgery post-London; weeks OR months depending on findings.
MHJ trade pending physical: HOU gets Marvin Harrison Jr + 2027 6th; ARI gets 2027 2nd + 7th.
CLE LB Carson Schwesinger Grade 1 ankle; Judkins day-to-day — both have chance Week 6.

Baker Mayfield (TB, thumb) OUT Week 6; Lamar Jackson (BAL, ankle) Questionable; Caleb Williams (CHI, hamstring) Questionable / Rapoport: could return; Marcus Mariota (JAX, knee/MCL) Doubtful per earlier reports — verify practice.
